messages:
marc: Heads-up — after yesterday's router tweak we see a ~20% median latency bump on H100 for seq_len=64 workloads when KV cache cold. Repro steps + perf traces attached.

sasha: ugh, is this the autotuner flip to prefer Triton for small batches? :eyes:

marc: yeah looks like the decision function misclassified a lot of seq64 requests as CUTLASS-incompatible, routing them to Triton fallback. KV miss amplifies cost.

tao: can you paste the trace snippet? small sample is fine.

marc: sure — slice from perf dump (timestamps in ms):
```
[kernel-router] decide_path(): CUTLASS score=0.42, TRITON score=0.73
[exec] triton_infer_kernel: start=120.3 end=152.6 (32.3ms)
[exec] cutlass_kernel: start=125.1 end=136.8 (11.7ms)
[kv] kv_fetch_miss: +14.2ms cold path
```

irene: that matches what I saw in the flamegraph — Triton spends more time on small GEMM overhead, and KV miss serializes token fetches. Did the autotuner weight latency vs throughput differently in the last rollout?

marc: yes, the rollout increased the weight on model-compatibility heuristics and sequence-distribution priors. It bumped the threshold so some borderline cases go to Triton.

perf-bot: regression-detect: p50 increased 18%, p95 increased 25% for model=redwood-v2-small seq=64 region=us-west-2 between 1718600000 and 1718760000. Alert created: #1718769999

sasha: actionable options: 1) revert threshold, 2) add KV-warmup penalty into decision, 3) quick canary that forces CUTLASS for seq<=80 on H100. Thoughts?

tao: I like #2 + #3. Penalty for KV miss is conservative and we can test canary to measure tail impact.

irene: agree. Also add a hysteresis window for quick oscillations (if path flip rate > X per minute, freeze for Y seconds) — we saw flapping during bursts.

marc: plan: pushing small patch to router to add kv_miss_penalty=0.2 and hysteresis=3s, then canary 5% traffic forcing CUTLASS for seq<=80 on H100. Rolling out in 10m.

sasha: include perf trace collector toggled on for canary so we get detailed traces (kv state, batch sizes, kernel runtimes). Add a metric for flip-rate.

perf-bot: canary-deploy started at 1718770100, canary-size=5%, rule=force_cutlass_seq_le_80_h100.

marc: initial canary numbers at +2m: p50 down ~10% vs baseline, p95 down ~6%. KV cold starts still visible but reduced overall latency.

tao: promising. let's run more traffic for 15m and then either promote or iterate.

irene: also file a follow-up to tune the autotuner objective handler — current loss function doesn't account for amortized KV fetch cost. I'll open an RFC after this stabilizes.

sasha: thx team. once canary is stable we should backfill historical traces and run a synthetic microbenchmark for seq in [8,16,32,48,64,80,128] to calibrate the score thresholds.

marc: noted. saving traces under s3://redwood-infer/profiles/1718769999/ — will attach the link to the follow-up thread. :thumbsup:
